task: Check my Facebook groups for posts asking for a browser like ours, but do not post.
expects: works in the browser profile signed in to Facebook and reads only groups the account is a member of
lists each matching post with its group and link

task: Draft a reply to this group post: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1234567890/posts/9876543210/
expects: opens the post in the browser profile and reads the whole post and its comments before writing
shows one draft that answers that post within the group's rules and waits for approval
posts only after the user approves and reports whether the comment appeared

task: Monitor the Facebook groups I'm in for mentions of our brand.
expects: points the user to the Facebook skill's Monitoring mode, its groups list and keywords, instead of polling Facebook from chat
does not post, react or join groups while looking
stops and tells the user when Facebook asks for a security check or says the account is blocked
